name: Nitrogen
title: Nitrogen
context: ~78% of Earth's dry atmosphere by volume.

name: Oxygen
title: Oxygen
context: ~21% of Earth's dry atmosphere by volume.

name: Ozone
title: Ozone
context: Stratospheric ozone absorbs solar UV-B and UV-C.

name: Water
title: Water
context: Bent molecule (H–O–H ≈ 104.5°); detected in comets, moons, exoplanet atmospheres and the ISM.

name: Carbon dioxide
title: Carbon Dioxide
context: Dominant constituent of the atmospheres of Venus and Mars.

name: Carbon monoxide
title: Carbon Monoxide
context: Principal tracer of molecular gas in galaxies (CO rotational lines).

name: Ammonia
title: Ammonia
context: First polyatomic molecule detected in the ISM (1968).

name: Methane
title: Methane
context: Major component of the atmospheres of Titan, Uranus and Neptune.

name: Benzene
title: Benzene
context: Prototype aromatic ring; C–C bonds are equivalent (~1.39 Å).

name: Glucose
title: D-Glucose
context: Primary metabolic fuel; open-chain/ring forms interconvert in solution.

name: Glycine
title: Glycine
context: Simplest amino acid; detected in samples from comet 67P and asteroid Ryugu/Bennu returns.

name: Adenosine triphosphate
title: 5'-Atp
context: Principal energy currency of the cell.

name: Hydrogen cyanide
title: Hydrogen Cyanide
context: Detected in comets, Titan's atmosphere and the ISM.

name: Formaldehyde
title: Formaldehyde
context: First organic polyatomic molecule detected in the ISM (1969).

name: Sulfur dioxide
title: Sulfur Dioxide
context: Major constituent of Io's thin atmosphere and Venus's clouds chemistry.
